anti_trude_vector.medium: Interactive Venetian-oriental architectural elevation & progressive chalk-bleaching ocular palimpsest with Scarlatti harpsichord/bell-to-chalk-step WebAudio synthesis

inner_arch: To the transient visitor (Day 1), Phyllis offers joyous architectural surprises at every point—nine distinct bridges over canals, every variety of window, four pavements including blue-and-white tiles, a caper bush jutting from a crag, three queens on corbels, onion domes with three little bulbous domes, and a woman combing her hair in a doorway. Yet if you must stay and spend the rest of your days in Phyllis, the city soon fades before your eyes: rose windows, corbel queens, domes, and tiles bleach into blank pages scanned by millions of unseeing eyes, leaving all the city invisible save zigzag footsteps between daily obligations, sparse benches, a door here, a stair there, and patches of sunlight—pierced only at rare unexpected instants by a caper bush or fleeting threshold silhouette.

phyllis-transient-marvel.role: Renders all 23 canonical first-arrival wonders (9 distinct canal bridges, 6 window varieties, 4 pavements, crag caper bush, 3 corbel queens, onion dome with 3 little bulbous domes, woman in doorway combing hair) + luminous harpsichord/bell WebAudio that damps into chalk clicks under habit.

phyllis-habit-bleacher.role: Models residence days (1..3650) and daily errand trudging that bleach ornate facades into blank chalk pages scanned by millions of eyes, leaving only dashed obligation zigzags, sparse benches/door/stair, and sunlight patches—punctured by rare unexpected instants.

phyllis-weaver.role: Composes 100% standalone zero-dependency index.html with custom DOM vocabulary, 1280x800 & 390x844 layouts, keyboard & reduced-motion support, and <phyllis-plate-drawer> [P] for map.png & image.png.

phyllis-critic.role: Blindfolded read-only verifier checking title-masked recognition, HG-1..HG-4 hard gates, and Royal Plates map.png, map.svg, and image.png.
